name: pdk-crossplane-etl
instr:
Our fleet collector no longer copies /etc/nginx off each host. It now runs `nginx -T` and uploads what that prints, one dump per host, and the audit job that hands configs to crossplane can't use those, because `crossplane.parse` only reads a config tree from disk.

Please add a `from_dump=True` option to `crossplane.parse` and a `--from-dump` flag to `crossplane parse`. Parsing a dump should give exactly the payload `crossplane.parse` gives for a tree holding the files in the dump at the paths the dump lists, with every other option and flag working as it does for a tree. The dump is the only source. Nothing is read from this machine's disk, even where a path from the dump exists here, and parsing several dumps in one process must not mix them up. Some uploads get cut off part way through. Those still have to parse, as a tree holding only what made it into the dump, with the cut file ending where the upload stopped.

Samples are in /data/fleet. web-03 and edge-01 each have the uploaded dump (nginx-T.txt) and a copy of the host's config tree taken at the same moment, under the same paths. lb-02 is a cut-off upload. Parsing a tree from disk must not change, and the existing tests in /app/tests have to keep passing. There's no network here.
